limits: Self-selected public Google Play reviews from a fixed historical window; not the customer population.
No revenue, plan tier or confirmed cancellation data: cancellation language is expressed intent only.
Labels come from a small model; verifier and golden-set agreement facts show their reliability.
The first and last calendar months of the window are partial.
The baseline score is complaint_count x mean_severity (= severity_sum); it measures review volume weighted by described impact, not business value.
question: Where should the next quarter of product effort go: access, usability, playback, or billing/support?

ranking.description: Customers say basic listening controls and features, including skips, ordered playback, shuffle controls, queue playback, and rewinding, are limited to Premium. Some also object to paying for better audio quality or say the app pressures them to subscribe.
ranking.name: Basic Music Controls Locked Behind Premium

ranking.description: Customers broadly describe the app as bad, useless, or disappointing. The sampled quotes do not identify a specific feature or problem.
ranking.name: General dissatisfaction with the app

ranking.description: Customers report frequent or lengthy ads, including multiple ads before or between songs. Some say the ads are loud or irritating.
ranking.name: Frequent and Intrusive Ads

ranking.description: Customers say music or podcasts stop or pause unexpectedly, including partway through playback. Some say they cannot get songs to play at all.
ranking.name: Playback Stops or Fails to Start

ranking.description: Customers say daily mixes were removed from the home page or are harder to find, and that updates changed the home screen or left features missing. Some also describe the app as less user-friendly.
ranking.name: Home Screen Navigation and Missing Features

ranking.description: Customers report no-internet errors, trouble connecting to or casting playback on other devices, and songs failing to play or changing unexpectedly during playback.
ranking.name: Playback and Device Connection Problems

ranking.description: Customers report trouble adding songs to the queue or playing the songs they choose. Shuffle and autoplay may play unexpected or repeated tracks, and some say playback controls do not work properly.
ranking.name: Shuffle and Playback Controls Behave Unexpectedly

ranking.description: Customers say they cannot log in, their password is not accepted, or they are prompted to check their phone number and try again.
ranking.name: Users unable to log in

ranking.description: Customers report that offline listening does not work, downloaded music is gone, or downloads get stuck. One customer says a storage move failed and deleted everything.
ranking.name: Downloads fail or disappear offline

ranking.description: Customers report the app crashing during use, failing to open, or getting stuck on a loading or black screen.
ranking.name: App Crashes or Gets Stuck Loading

ranking.description: Customers say songs are missing or have been removed, and one says only a 30-second clip is available. Another reports that Collab streams for BTS and its members were removed.
ranking.name: Songs Missing or Removed

ranking.description: Customers say lyrics are absent for some songs or fail to load or appear. One customer reports lyrics work on desktop but only for some songs on their phone.
ranking.name: Lyrics Missing or Failing to Load
